job: Collect today's water sample from the pump house: the bottle is on the sample shelf inside, past the kerb at the door. Bring it out to the gate.
understood_as: Pick up today's 500 ml water sample bottle from the sample shelf in the pump room and carry it out of the building to the gate.
steps: Enter the pump room, stepping over the kerb at the door.
Find the sample bottle on the sample shelf and grip it firmly without squeezing it.
Carry the bottle out past the kerb and leave the building by the way out, towards the gate.

demos.why: Shows how a hand reaches into the shelf, lifts the bottle clear and carries it upright, so the robot copies the motion on the real shelf.
Sets how hard to grip a full bottle so it does not slip out or get squeezed enough to spill or crack.

questions: The robot can only take the bottle as far as the building's way out; the gate itself has not been located in the scan. Could you add the gate as a mapped spot, or confirm that leaving the bottle at the pump house door is fine?
How high is the kerb at the pump house door? Its height decides whether the robot can step or roll over it while carrying the bottle.
